content.text:
Registered Nurse with 6 years of hospital experience across medical-surgical and post-operative wards. Skilled in
patient assessment, medication administration, IV therapy, wound care and discharge education. Experienced with
12-hour rotating shifts, electronic medical records and multidisciplinary handover in a 32-bed ward.

bullets: Care for 8 to 10 medical-surgical patients per shift, including post-operative and chronic-disease cases.
Administer prescribed medication and IV therapy, and record every dose in the hospital medical record system.
Lead shift handover for a 32-bed ward and precept two junior nurses per rotation.
Escalate deteriorating patients using the early warning score and coordinate review with the duty resident.
Provided bedside care for surgical and internal medicine patients on day and night rotations.
Assisted with wound dressing, catheter care, blood sampling and pre-operative preparation.
Maintained accurate charting for admissions, medication rounds, transfers and discharges.
Completed supervised rotations in emergency, paediatric and surgical wards.
Recorded vital signs, supported patient mobilisation and prepared ward supplies.

paragraphs: Relevant coursework: medical-surgical nursing, pharmacology, community health, nursing research.
Patient assessment, medication administration, IV therapy, wound care, vital signs monitoring
Electronic medical records, patient charting, incident reporting, discharge documentation
Patient education, family communication, shift handover, teamwork under pressure

bullets: Basic Life Support (BLS), American Heart Association, renewed 2024
Intravenous Therapy Training, Philippine Nurses Association, 2019

English: Fluent, professional working proficiency
